script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. PARK - DAY

BEN, a young, handsome artist in his late twenties, sits on a bench facing the lush greenery of the park. He sketches in a notebook, humming softly to himself. A woman, JESSICA, in her early thirties, wearing a red dress, approaches him.

JESSICA
(smiling)
Beautiful day, isn't it?

BEN
(looking up, surprised)
Yes, it is.

They share an awkward pause, then Ben offers her a seat.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica and Ben sit across from each other, sipping their coffees.

JESSICA
So, you're an artist? What do you usually draw?

BEN
Mainly landscapes. But I enjoy drawing people, too.

JESSICA
Interesting. I've always been curious about the artistic mind.

BEN
(laughs)
Well, there's nothing particularly interesting about it. Just a lot of imagination and dedication.

They continue talking, discovering common interests and laughter.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Ben and Jessica stand in front of one of Ben's paintings, surrounded by admirers.

BEN
(smiling)
I'm glad you like it.

JESSICA
(looking up at him)
I love it.

A man, MIKE, approaches them, looking angry.

MIKE
(pointing at Ben)
I can't believe you sold that piece to her. You know how much I paid for it.

BEN
(calmly)
I'm sorry, Mike. It was a mistake. But this piece belongs to Jessica now.

Mike storms off, leaving Ben and Jessica shocked.

EXT. PARK - DAY

Ben and Jessica sit on the same bench where they first met.

BEN
(sighing)
I'm so sorry about that scene back at the gallery. I didn't mean to embarrass you.

JESSICA
(placing a hand on his)
It's okay. I understand that mistakes happen.

BEN
But what if that mistake costs me my career?

JESSICA
(smiling)
Then we'll start over. Together.

INT. ART STUDIO - NIGHT

Ben and Jessica work on a new piece together, their hands intertwined.

BEN
(looking at her)
Thank you for believing in me.

JESSICA
(smiling)
Anytime.

They continue working in silence, creating something beautiful together.

FADE OUT.

THE END
